chapter: Jazz at parties and social acceptance
title: Her parents and their friends as jazz enthusiasts
summary: Her parents and their friends wanted only jazz or classical music, and were great jazz enthusiasts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did your parents and your parents contemporaries say about it?
Oh, they were strictly for jazz and nothing else as far as party music. There were only two kinds of music as far as they were concerned, classical music and jazz.
Not your parents, what about your parents' friends?
Well, most of my parents' friends thought the same way. They've always been great jazz enthusiasts.
Alright. How old are your parents then? Uh...
Uh... My father's in his early 50s, my mother's in her late 40s. Uh...
